name: Mind over Body
body:
You heal ability damage at an astounding rate.

Prerequisite: Con 13.

Benefit: You heal ability damage and ability burn more quickly than normal. You heal a number of ability points per day equal to 1 + your Constitution modifier.

Normal: You heal ability damage and ability burn at a rate of 1 point/day.
